title: Model and Data
description: Study the implementation in [src/model.py] and [src/data.py]. Trace its declarations and dependencies into a caller or test. Prominent declared symbols visible in the inspected excerpt include resume_features, draft_interview_questions, _matrix, train, make_resume, parse_resume, load_data; confirm their complete definitions and callers in the file.

learning_objectives.text: Explain the source role and visible behavior in src/model.py, src/data.py.
Trace a declaration, setting, or documented claim to a caller, test, or implementation path.
Separate source evidence, documentation claims, and unverified runtime behavior.

completion_criteria: Submit the code-trace exercise meeting all acceptance criteria.
